source: supplied bz2_art.7z direct files plus embedded ZIP material members

mapping_policy.ambient_rgb: preserve as source metadata; no direct glTF PBR equivalent
mapping_policy.specular_rgb: KHR_materials_specular with normalized/clamped color and factor
mapping_policy.reflectivity: preserve as source metadata; explicitly not mapped to metallic
mapping_policy.refractive_index: KHR_materials_ior only when source value is >=1 and non-default

notes: The previous provisional MTR decoder began four bytes late. Diffuse/specular/shininess happened to line up, but it incorrectly treated refractive index as alpha.
The corrected alignment explains the named Softimage glass family: nonzero transparency, high reflectivity and IOR 1.1.
Reflectivity is an authored Softimage reflection control and must not be conflated with a physically based metallic workflow without further render validation.
